name: Onchain Yield Coin
oneLiner: ONYC is a Solana-based NAV-accreting yield token backed by OnRe-managed structured insurance and reinsurance positions; not a hard $1 peg.
collateral: Tokenized exposure to OnRe-managed structured insurance and reinsurance yield products, designed to hold stable value while distributing real-world insurance-market returns through NAV appreciation
pegMechanism: ONYC is a yield-bearing stable-value token rather than a fixed $1 wrapper; the token value accrues yield from OnRe's structured insurance collateral strategies, with primary-market access governed by OnRe's platform terms

jurisdiction.license: IIGB and DABA licenses (Segregated Accounts Company)

proofOfReserves.provider: Apex Insurance Fund Services Ltd. monthly agreed-upon-procedures NAV statements (cover pages state 'Un-audited'; administrator-level independence - Apex administers the NAV it reports; unbroken monthly series Nov 2025 through Jun 2026, view-only Google Drive links)

mechanismArchetypeReview.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 implementation-date review
mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: OnRe's 4 July 2025 media release announces ONyc's launch as tokenized reinsurance collateral. Current OnRe documentation describes ONyc as a Solana token representing a proportional interest in a regulated Bermuda segregated account with NAV-based value, matching the tracked rwa-credit-fund mechanism. This dated launch is the determinable boundary for the current product implementation.
